heroSummary: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2028–29 school year on Monday, July 24, 2028, and lists Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last day for students. The family calendar includes 180 student days, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 conference half days, semester half days, and a June 4–29 summer school window.
calendarNotes: The 2028–29 GPS calendar continues the district’s pattern of early starts, May endings, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 conference half days, grading days, and semester day counts.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Gilbert Public Schools start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2028–29 school year on Monday, July 24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Gilbert Public Schools winter break in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break runs from Friday, December 22, 2028, through Friday, January 5, 2029. Students return Monday, January 8.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Gilbert calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Gilbert Public Schools revisions.
